answer: A stake-backed registry makes each new agent anchor a verified funding source to its identity and stake a bond slashed on proven collusion. Agents sharing one wallet fail the anchor check. The bond sets the attack price: ten thousand identities at a five dollar floor lock fifty thousand dollars, and one duplicate-funding signal forfeits the cluster while honest agents are refunded. Cost rises with identities tried. Slashing raises the bond floor for all sharing that graph, so the economic zenith is a Sybil farm turning into a self-punishing ivory tower, pricier as it grows.
